title: Thank you!!!!
body: As a fellow fan of the NFL Street Series, thank you so much for trying to bring back that awesome arcadey goodness! This game has so much potential and room to become the true spiritual successor to that legendary series. Already the game feels really fun and unique yet comfortingly familiar. My only recommendations would be add new football ball skins, add new weather conditions, more stadiums, more customization options for players (such as glasses, headbands, hats, etc) add a virtual controller setting so you can tap a button to pass to a receiver, juke, wall run etc. Add some music and maybe a campaign like mode either as a ladder format or rogue like mode. Over all though this is a great start and I look forward to seeing how this game continues to evolve! 👍👍5/5
